name: visionflow-diagram-render
description: Diagram-as-code render gate (RES-b). Renders presentation/report/diagrams/*.mmd to light-theme SVG with Pele (sha256-pinned in scripts/vendor/pele, in-process, no browser and no npm runtime dependency): every Pele CSS variable is flattened to its concrete light default, and a white background and an explicit text fill are baked into every SVG.
